data.one_liner: Widget that adds trigger‑based autocomplete to text fields
data.what_it_does: MultiTriggerAutocomplete provides a text field with support for multiple autocomplete triggers such as @, #, and : . It shows a portal‑based options view that can be customized per trigger.
use_when: Implementing mention, hashtag or emoji autocompletion in chat or comment UIs
Adding custom trigger‑based suggestions to a single text field
Need a lightweight, declarative solution without code generation
avoid_when: Using a non‑Flutter platform that cannot host a Portal
When you need a global state‑management solution for autocomplete data
strengths: Supports multiple triggers in one widget
Built on flutter_portal for flexible overlay placement
Easy to integrate with existing TextField or TextFormField
weaknesses: Only works with text fields, not rich text editors
Limited to single‑line or multiline text with selection handling
data.setup_notes: Add Portal at the top of the widget tree and include multi_trigger_autocomplete in pubspec
